description: The caller workflows a repo installs, fetched by fixdings/claude-setup's github flow from the floating major tag the callers pin. `source` is the file's path in this repo; it is installed as .github/workflows/<its file name>, unchanged. Each caller's `uses:` names a reusable workflow of this repo at that tag. The three this repo runs itself live in .github/workflows/; callers/ holds the one it does not.

callers.summary: Runs Claude when a comment says @claude.
Reviews every PR; keep this file's name and path, the other callers match the review run by both.
Fixes a blocking review round on a PR Claude opened.
Merges a PR whose review is CLEAN, or labels it needs-human. Opt-in: needs 0 required approvals and squash merging.
